selected_project.camera: OV5640 DVP RGB, not RK USB Astra RGB-D

telemetry.interpretation: Prospective incompatibility with new upstream V4; not evidence that current board emits V4 or that V4 caused earlier USB failure.

pid.new: registered pid_run plus sample_pending retain arming-coincident sample; raw enable/fault/PWM gates remain

uart_rx.new: shared sequential two24-cycle divide-by1000, 48clocks=0.96us at50MHz after CRC, outputs committed together
uart_rx.ownership: standalone UART retains last valid speed/yaw to reset; preserve joint lease/host-loss guards and IR override

actual_review.ring_and_action_pipeline: Upstream mem_policy retains old flat-history interface. Wholesale replacement would remove joint OBS_RING_STORAGE/action-preview integration.

camera_storage.qualification: Independent capacity lower bound for keeping current joint mapping; not an actual camera+NAV synthesis or proof against storage redesign.

extra_peripheral_cst.qualification: Static IO_LOC comparison only, not electrical/clock/board signoff.

actual_review.SDC: Camera clock and LCD auto-generated clock listed, false-path entries Actived. No input/output delay budgets in supplied main.sdc; not complete board IO signoff.
actual_review.docs: README retains stale V2/old-bitstream statements despite current-version V4 manifest; prioritize current_version.json, enabled project and source.

proposed_sequence: Keep SYN50/PNR63 as reviewed joint integration base.
Add backward-compatible V4 telemetry decode and explicit diagnostic display, then export diagnostics through existing joint wrappers.
Port PID arming sample fix as isolated candidate, verify reset/disable/feedback/zero-balance contracts in actual joint context.
Keep RK USB RGB-D path; treat FPGA OV5640/LCD as a separate memory and clock redesign if required.
Perform new physical and vehicle acceptance only on the selected combined candidate; no direct upstream .fs replacement.
